claim_2_magnitude_twin_reconstruction.statement: the twin's own Fmax budget, converted to fingertip force via its own geometry, reaches realistic max-grip norms
claim_2_magnitude_twin_reconstruction.pre_registered_threshold: predicted grip force >= EWGSOP2 low-strength cutoff (the most charitable real benchmark) under a steelmanned (generous budget, most-favorable ratio) assumption
claim_2_magnitude_twin_reconstruction.adversary_forced: steelmanned with generous budget (455.4N, all closing-relevant muscles) and most-favorable single-joint (DIP, 3.40x) transmission ratio, cross-checked against Schuind 1992's real in-vivo 3.43x

geometric_transmission_ratios.method: single-joint lever balance F_tendon/F_tip = L/r using twin's own measured r and L (L_distal literature-estimated)

external_cross_check.comparison: within 1% of twin's independently-derived DIP-joint geometric estimate (3.40x)
external_cross_check.caveat: tip pinch not power grip, small n, CTS-surgical population; convergence may be partly coincidental given approximations
